notes: Music: slow, atmospheric tracks that drift in and out. Each of the 21 worlds has its own, the Hollow Harvest has a spooky waltz, and every menu theme plays its own tune at camp. Tracks crossfade as you move between camp and a run, or when the world shifts in Endless.
Music settings: a volume slider and mute in Settings, separate from sound effects, and a Music toggle in the pause menu.

29 new boons, for 53 in all: 11 Common, 12 Rare, 3 Legendary, 2 Mythic and 1 Exotic. Look for armor piercing, crit and range picks, cheaper building, better selling, more boon XP, new Rares for 11 lanterns, Phalanx (bonus damage for groups of the same lantern), Double tap (a chance to reload instantly), Time warp (all foes move slower) and Eternal night.
Lantern boons are only offered while that lantern is on the board.
Surge and Moonfall are never your head start pick, and stop showing up once every lantern on the board is fully upgraded.

Sound effects: soft taps and chimes in the menus, purchases and rewards, and a quiet signature sound for every lantern, plus cues for waves, bosses, boon picks, leaks, wins and losses. Busy waves are kept calm on purpose: sounds are throttled and softly mixed.
Sound settings: a volume slider and mute button in Settings, and a quick Sound toggle in the pause menu. Sound and music pause when you leave the app.

Landscape mode. On computers, tablets and phones turned sideways the board turns so the trail runs left to right, with your stats, buttons and lanterns in a column beside it. Phones held upright play exactly as before.
New Screen layout setting: Auto, Portrait or Landscape. Auto follows the shape of your screen, and you can switch at any time, even mid-run.
The home screen, Lanterns page and boon picks have side-by-side layouts for phones turned sideways, so they fit without scrolling.
The installed app now follows your device’s rotation instead of locking to portrait.
title: The Wide Night
